items.name: clutch-original
items.title: CLUTCH ORIGINAL
items.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished high resolution landscape product concept board for one CLUTCH esports profile customization pack. French text, dark midnight navy surrounding canvas, premium sports app art direction. Consistent catalog composition: small CLUTCH wordmark upper left, large pack title across top and short material subtitle. Top middle: a large wide complete equipped player profile card taking 40% of board height, labeled 'Carte équipée'. Main card shows illustrated dark-haired young adult male hooded esports avatar (same character concept for all packs), readable 'FabTheTap', 'Supporter FNATIC', tiny bronze rank symbol and 'Bronze', 'Saison 1'. Bottom middle: THREE clearly separated complete product objects laid out horizontally with labels 'Cadre d’avatar', 'Fond de carte', 'Signature'. Frame must be shown EMPTY with dark interior, fully visible, not a zoomed crop. Background must be shown as a whole wide card WITHOUT avatar or text. Signature must be shown as a separate narrow nameplate containing 'FabTheTap'. Never substitute a logo for signature. Show actual consistent matching components used on main card. At bottom a slim labeled 'Dans le classement' row: '#3', tiny framed avatar, 'FabTheTap', '620 Frags', styled to match. Keep all content inside generous margins, crisp legible typography, restrained detail, no phones, no purchase buttons, no prices, no extraneous slogans. Avatar and rank are context, not advertised as included except explicit starter avatars. This is one individual pack sheet, NOT a multi-pack comparison board. Pack title 'CLUTCH ORIGINAL'. Subtitle 'Noir texturé · Jaune acide'. Specific visual direction: Black subtly textured material, acid yellow diagonal Clutch stripe, angular black avatar frame with yellow corner inserts. Starter sports gaming identity. Include extra row labeled '3 avatars inclus' showing three separate selectable illustrated portraits: hooded dark-haired young man, short-haired young woman in ivory jacket, curly-haired young man in red sports jersey. Add small label 'Inclus à l’inscription'.

items.name: 15-avatars-gaming
items.title: 15 avatars gaming
items.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup / character concept collection. Create one high resolution landscape contact sheet for CLUTCH esports prediction app, showing EXACTLY 15 distinct original gaming profile AVATARS in a strict 5 columns by 3 rows grid. Header 'CLUTCH — CHOISIS TON AVATAR'. Subtitle '15 identités gaming'. Every avatar is a large separate square portrait, same size, simple dark neutral square thin border, head and shoulders closeup, faces occupying 65 percent of tile, readable silhouette for small mobile leaderboard icons. Uniform premium hand-painted stylized video game character art, angular shapes, expressive faces, polished esports art, not photoreal, not chibi. Dark navy canvas, ample gutters and labels below each square. No team logos, no real game logos, no ranks, no stats, no ornate cosmetic frames; these are the underlying collectible avatars, compatible with any pack. Different face shapes, skin tones, genders and ages (all adults), different hairstyles and species. Original characters inspired by esports GENRES without copying existing franchise characters. Each tile has ONLY exact numbered name underneath. Row one tactical FPS and futuristic competitive characters: '01 · SPECTRE' a hooded masked stealth male, dark fabric and red accent, eyes visible; '02 · NOVA' a dark-skinned female futuristic duelist with short white hair and cyan collar; '03 · VECTOR' an East Asian male composed tactical shotcaller, angular glasses and dark green headset; '04 · GLITCH' an androgynous hacker with asymmetric purple hair and violet cybernetic temple; '05 · BULWARK' a broad armored sci-fi guardian with a distinctive closed helmet and amber visor. Row two MOBA fantasy and RPG characters: '06 · EMBER' a red-haired female fire mage, warm copper glowing accents; '07 · RONIN' an adult male swordfighter, tied black hair, weathered face, minimal crimson armor, no sword covering face; '08 · NYX' a dark violet-skinned elven female assassin, pale eyes and pointed ears; '09 · ORION' a silver-haired male celestial mage, deep blue robe and discreet stars; '10 · SYLVA' a brown-skinned female forest ranger, green hood and strong confident gaze. Row three fighting games, rocket racing and esports mascots: '11 · K.O.' a Black female fighting-game champion with braids, red athletic collar and one gloved fist near shoulder; '12 · BOOST' a futuristic racing pilot in black orange helmet with visor raised to reveal adult face; '13 · BYTE' a charming angular small robot head, bright turquoise expressive digital eyes, high quality gaming mascot; '14 · FANG' an anthropomorphic wolf competitor with white grey fur, intense gold eyes and black esports jacket; '15 · ACE' a curly-haired young adult male esports pro with warm medium skin, black acid-yellow jersey and gaming headset. Keep unmistakably distinct faces and silhouettes, balanced mix of serious and charismatic personalities. All portraits front or three-quarter view at same scale, backgrounds are subtle dark single-color gradients matching each character accent. No weapons foreground, no extra characters, no microtext, no decorative slogans. Make all 15 tiles fully visible and labels accurate.
